title: RunEndedPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

reason.description: Why a run ended: completed, error, interrupted (with its cause), disposed (the environment let the run go: its session was deleted, or the environment closed), drained (cut by a drain's cap).

anyOf.description: What interrupted a run: user (runs.interrupt), read-now, restart (the recovery sweep after a restart), parked (its process was stopped while parked on a prompt), timeout (a routine's firing ran past its maximum duration).

cause.description: What interrupted the run, when its reason is interrupted; else null.

code.description: The provider's or the environment's code for it, when there is one.

anyOf.description: What went wrong in a run: a message and, when there is one, a code.

error.description: What went wrong, when the reason is error; else null.

costUsd.description: What the tokens cost in US dollars, when the provider says.

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens, when the provider says.

items.description: One model's token spend in a run: input, output, cache reads and writes, cost and context window.

usage.description: The run's token spend per model, when the provider reported it.

durationMs.description: From run.started to run.ended, on the environment's clock.

turnCount.description: The provider's turns in the run, when it says.

resultText.description: The run's final answer as the provider reports it, when it does.

description: run.ended: the run ended, once, on every path; its endedAt is the event's occurredAt.
